listings.title: Postdoctoral Researcher — Scientific Machine Learning for PDEs on Wasserstein Space

listings.title: Doctoral student in Technology and Society on regulatory learning and supervisory competence

listings.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Political Science

listings.summary: The Department of Political Science at the University of Gothenburg invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral fellow position within the BIG PEACE research project. listings.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Political Science
listings.summary: The University of Gothenburg's Department of Political Science invites applications for a postdoctoral fellow within the Dying Occupations and Political Change (OCCPOL) project. This role suits researchers with a completed PhD in political science or a related quantitative social science field, interested in computational methods and comparative political analysis.
